title: Accessory off-street parking spaces for buildings containing hotel uses
previewText: For the zoning lot south of First Place and east of Battery Place, accessory off-street parking spaces for hotel uses may be provided at the rate established for transient hotels in Section 13-12 (Permitted Parking for Non-residential Uses) or 13-13 (Permitted Parking for Zoning Lots With Multiple Uses), as applicable.
